children: Copley Acquisition adjourned its shareholder meeting to November 2, 2026, as it seeks approval to extend its business-combination deadline and increased the proposed monthly trust contribution to $200,000.
The extraordinary general meeting was moved from October 29 to November 2, giving shareholders more time to consider the extension proposals.
The proposals would allow up to 12 one-month extensions, moving the deadline from November 2, 2026, to November 2, 2027.
The Sponsor or its designees would contribute $200,000 for each monthly extension, up from the previously proposed $150,000.
Copley waived the right to use up to $100,000 of trust interest for dissolution expenses and waived interest withdrawals for future tax expenses.
